## Professional Summary

AI systems developer and founder of Joe's Tech Solutions: custom software, AI agents, automation, and private AI for small businesses, built on the same stack he runs his own company on, with three active client builds (a rental-turnover agent and an artist website, both live, and a salon app in TestFlight beta). Runs Hermes, Nous Research's open-source agent runtime, as a multi-agent AI team: Lurkr, his orchestrator agent, as CTO, with executive skills (Chief of Staff, CFO, COO, CMO), VPs for Engineering, Infrastructure, and Product, and 40+ scheduled automations with models pinned per job on Ollama Cloud. Ship full-stack applications using React/React Native, TypeScript, Python, and PostgreSQL. Use AI coding assistants daily as core development tools.

Previously: ran a multi-agent setup on the open-source OpenClaw runtime (22 specialized agents, 2024–2026), then migrated to Hermes after learning composability beats specialization. He did not build OpenClaw. The migration postmortem is the OpenClaw → Hermes case study on this site.

Previously: 10 years as an autonomous vehicle systems specialist. Part of the team that built Google's Firefly autonomous vehicle. Supported the world's first fully driverless ride on public roads (2015). Subject Matter Expert for drive-by-wire systems across the first 100 Google self-driving cars and 10 hardware iterations. Managed sensor calibration operations for the entire Google AV fleet — final release authority. Led fleet operations at Uber ATG and Pronto.ai. ITAR-controlled hardware experience. Then 5+ years learning AI tools, code, and building personal and client projects.

## Key Achievement: Hermes (Multi-Agent AI Team)

AI operations system Joe runs for his own business, with models pinned per job on Ollama Cloud. Built on Nous Research's open-source hermes-agent (github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent); Joe configures and runs it, he did not write the runtime.

- **Architecture:** Lurkr, Joe's orchestrator agent, as CTO, executive skills (Chief of Staff, CFO, COO, CMO), VPs for Engineering, Infrastructure, and Product, and 40+ scheduled automations
- **Model Routing:** Ollama Cloud model selection by task
- **Capabilities:** Daily morning briefs, evening plans, per-project checks, uptime watchdogs, weekly reviews, deployment pipelines, content drafting, security sweeps
- **Memory:** MemPalace, a third-party memory tool (semantic search, knowledge graph), persistent across sessions
- **Skills:** Reusable patterns for recurring workflows
- **Cron Jobs:** Daily/weekly jobs (morning brief, evening plan, content draft, security sweep, weekly model bakeoff)
- **Migration:** Retired the 22-agent setup he ran on the open-source OpenClaw runtime in 2026; the case study covers the migration

## Projects

### Hermes — Multi-Agent AI Team (Current)
AI operations system Joe runs for his own business: Lurkr, his orchestrator agent, as CTO, executive skills, C-suite, VPs for Engineering/Infrastructure/Product, and 40+ scheduled automations with models pinned per job on Ollama Cloud. Persistent memory (MemPalace, third-party), skills system. Built on Nous Research's open-source hermes-agent; Joe configures and runs it. Handles real business operations: daily briefings, project stewards, watchdogs, weekly executive reviews, deployments, content drafting.

### OpenClaw → Hermes — Migration Case Study
Why Joe retired the 22-agent specialized setup he ran on the open-source OpenClaw runtime for a composable executive-led team. Design for composability, not specialization. The lesson generalizes.

### The Skate Workshop — React Native Mobile App
One-on-one skateboarding coaching app (Expo / React Native + Supabase) for a skate coach of Olympians: clip markup with drawings and voice notes, homework, a 4,952-combination trick grid, iOS push notifications. TestFlight beta only, never submitted to the app stores; development is paused.
Pre-launch site: theskateworkshop.app

### Career Ops (santifer's open-source project, run by Joe)
Career-Ops is santifer's open-source AI job-search system (github.com/career-ops-hq/career-ops). Joe runs a customized fork for his own job search; he did not build it. It evaluates offers with scoring, generates ATS-optimized CVs and pre-fills applications.

### DALL-E Image Generator (2023 learning demo)
A 2023 tutorial-based learning demo on the OpenAI DALL-E API, still live at jblas-dall-e.com.

### Whisper Walkie — Open Source Voice Typing
Open-source (MIT) push-to-talk dictation for Windows, macOS and Linux. It transcribes locally with OpenAI's open Whisper models through the faster-whisper library. github.com/joestechsolutions/whisper-walkie

### Cloud Infrastructure Projects
Multicloud Terraform deployment (AWS/GCP), K8s migration with Cloud SQL HA, legacy modernization with Anthos/GKE.

### cv-joseph — This Portfolio (Open Source)
Interactive CV with AI chatbot, Gemini Live voice mode, RAG pipeline, and multi-layer defense, built on Santiago Fernández's (santifer's) open-source cv-santiago template and extended by Joe. github.com/joblas/cv-joseph

## Portfolio Case Studies

### The Turnover Agent
Case study: a Telegram-first LLM ops agent for a short-term-rental manager: iCal checkout detection, cleaner messaging (Telegram-first), escalation ladders and watchdogs. In production since late July 2026.

### The Archive Beta Loop
Case study: my client's Telegram messages become shipped app features through an always-on Claude Code loop — with written guardrails on exactly what ships without me. As of the 2026-09-01 write-up: 20 issues, 13 merged PRs, 10 OTA updates, a 13.8-minute median from message to merged fix.

### Cbarrgs: website, Shopify merch store and site agent
Joe builds and maintains cbarrgs.com (Vite + React on Cloudflare Pages) for the electronic and ambient artist Cbarrgs, and set up the artist's Shopify merch storefront at shopify.cbarrgs.com (t-shirts, a pin and a sticker pack), wired into the site.

### The Cbarrgs Agent
Case study: my musician client's website is maintained by a Claude Code agent that lives inside the site's repo and answers his Telegram messages. Written charter, pairing-gated access, a 5-minute watchdog, and honest launch-week numbers.

### The Skate Workshop Loop
Case study: rebuilding a Slack-native agent dev loop after v1 died in public. A two-pass audit with receipts, three hardened edge-function redeploys, and a live test that stopped one stale credential short of end to end.
